availableLibraries.reuseDecision: Do not reuse external library values or the unrelated Detailed Frameworks search results.

foundations: geometry, borders, depth, focus and controls
components: fifteen canonical Phase B component contracts
excluded: candidate-only Product Feature Bento as separate authority
live video, WebGL or JavaScript motion inside Figma
consumer routes, analytics, consent or live content
new visual values invented in Figma
Code Connect before the mirrored library structure is approved

conflictsAndResolutions.conflict: A single Figma text style cannot encode CSS clamp() behaviour exactly.
conflictsAndResolutions.resolution: Create the fifteen semantic role styles at documented authoring reference values and place the exact canonical clamp formula beside each role; code remains runtime authority.

conflictsAndResolutions.conflict: Five canonical modes may exceed a four-mode collection limit.
conflictsAndResolutions.resolution: Use one primitive collection plus Colour · Web for light/dark and Colour · Output for email/document/print, with semantic variables aliasing primitives.

conflictsAndResolutions.conflict: Breakpoints, receiver-led profiles and density behaviour are runtime rules rather than independent visual values.
conflictsAndResolutions.resolution: Mirror named variables where supported and document the canonical profiles with representative auto-layout examples.

conflictsAndResolutions.conflict: Figma cannot execute the canonical Living Core, halftone video or marquee motion runtimes.
conflictsAndResolutions.resolution: Use exact static authoring twins and contract annotations; never substitute a new approximate effect.

conflictsAndResolutions.conflict: The historical file contains broad research sections but no reusable library primitives.
conflictsAndResolutions.resolution: Preserve it unchanged and create a new dedicated Figma companion after the Phase 0 gate.

recommendedBuildOrder: Foundation controls and product identity primitives
Canonical expressions and fifteen Phase B components
Standalone components and static runtime representations
Patterns, journeys and Golden Homepage documentation
Accessibility, naming, detach and cross-mode audit
Optional Code Connect plan after library approval

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Approve the Phase 0 scope and conflict resolutions so a new dedicated Figma companion can be created?
